notifyConfig.title: Async Notify Config
notifyConfig.infoBanner: Async notify config receives business event callbacks pushed by the platform. Please fill in an https callback URL accessible from the public network
notifyConfig.notifyUrlTooltip: Event notifications will be pushed to this URL via HTTP POST, must start with https://
